notes.title: FPS + Balance Update + Selection bugfix (test)
notes.notes:
Made some changes to how selecting buildings works, hopefully this will fix the selection bug, but it needs testing

Reduced the amount of units and made all units slightly stronger

Increased health of economy units to reduce tower effiency

Economy units (builders and plunderers) no longer attack, they just cower in fear (stand still) when an enemy is too close

Removed extra unit upgrades

Slightly adjusted combat unit logic to increase FPS

Adjusted building costs, unit costs and starting resources

Please report any bugs, feedback or requests on Discord: https://discord.com/invite/tsmeD5QwEM

notes.title: Balancing Update + Lobby Fix
notes.notes:
There was a bug that only allowed one lobby to be open at the time. This has hopefully been fixed.

Adjusted building and unit costs so wood becomes much more important at the start and stone is something you can (optionally) transition into.

Removed the option to build stone buildings at the start, you can upgrade the base to unlock stone buildings.

Builders now pause for 12 seconds if they do not have enough resources to continue building. This allows economy units to spawn so your economy does not completely break.

There's still a major bug in the selection system, I'm trying to fix this asap. If you cannot select buildings, completely close the game and restart, that should fix it.

I'm aware the building and selection systems are not optimal, this will be fixed in the future. For now, just click around a bit until you get the right building selected. If builders are blocking your selection, you can send them away by starting a building somewhere far away and then destroying the building. Or just destroy the builder.

notes.title: Economy and Tower update
notes.notes:
Economy spawners now spawn 5 units each instead of 2. They can be futher upgraded to spawn up to 10 units.

Added an upgrade to the base that lets you add armor to all economy units - very useful against towers.

Updated unit costs and stats.

There's one game breaking bug I know about out there. Sometimes the 2nd player is not able to select anything. When this happens it's best to just restart the game. You need to be able to select things to upgrade them, which is a big part of the game. I'm trying to fix this, but it's proving very hard to figure out.

Please @ me on Discord if you'd like to play: https://discord.com/invite/tsmeD5QwEM

notes.title: Update 2025/08/12 - 1
notes.notes:
- Balanced economy
- Reduced the amount of units and made units stronger
- Adjusted a lot of damage and health values for everything
- Reworked Combat Unit logic, game should run better now at higher unit counts
- Plunderers now stand still and fight back if enemy units are in range
- Added Victory/Defeat messages at the end of the game
- Fixed an FPS limit issue in the starting menu
- Added a button to disable spawning Combat Units

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Added Golem animation and adjusted their attacks.
Added Builder pathing.
Rotated Camera for player 2 and adjusted camera starting locations for both players.
Fixed Party Menu authentication error.

notes.title: Hotfix for last update
notes.notes:
Fixed tower position
Fixed healthbars getting wrong color sometimes

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where Plunderers would stop working when their Spawner was destroyed.
Fixed a bug where Farms would only spawn one Farmer. They now spawn 5 again.
Fixed a bug that wouldn't allow selecting/deselecting things properly.

Added healthbar colors.
Adjusted the position of the towers in the middle.

notes.title: Big Update
notes.notes:
- Towers have more health but less damage
- All units have been updated
- Updated some visuals
- Added some animations
- Added tooltips to building buttons on hover

The game should be in a testable state right now, though still far from finished. Please report any bugs on Discord.
